policy_contracts.behavior: open once and schedule exactly proposer critic and arbiter
block integration until explicit governed open then schedule exactly proposer critic and arbiter
record exact skip before any council round fact or launch and schedule no council execution

subject_contract.v18_revalidation: rebuild exact author production provenance plus primary and adversarial approve gate at every council write and integration admission processing

role_contract.artifact_rule: one strict envelope per role contains role body ballot and typed evidence; proposer derives proposal plus ballot critic derives critique plus ballot arbiter derives ballot; every derived fact references the same CAS artifact

decision_contract.dissent: accepted derives dissent for reject or abstain; rejected derives dissent for accept or abstain; no_consensus derives dissent for all three ballots; blocked_security derives dissent for every non_veto ballot
decision_contract.integration: only explicit integration command may proceed and must revalidate V18 gate plus exact typed council resolution
decision_contract.replan_causality: every Director replan proposal and successor binds source CouncilDecisionRef CouncilDecisionDigest and CouncilSubjectDigest

resolution_contract.mutual_exclusion: exactly one accepted_round or skip binding is present on integration action intent admission and processing
resolution_contract.target_digest: bind resolution kind common subject digest and the selected ref plus digest

persistence_contract.recovery: validate round_to_change_to_v18_gate fact_to_launch decision_skip_veto_and_pending_integration without duplicate launch or fact

invariants: council never replaces V18 author production provenance primary and adversarial reviews test attestation or Director lease
one immutable policy belongs to one exact council subject and the three policies are mutually exclusive
auto and required differ by opener while using the same three council roles and decision rules
skip is a human authorization fact and never a ballot decision or synthetic launch
all council deliberation facts derive from three real distinct launches and strict typed artifacts
ballot identity derives from its accredited launch and cannot cross project generation subject role or attempt
security veto is explicit typed evidence and never inferred from words severity aliases or logs
normal decisions wait for all three ballots and preserve minority dissent
accepted council output permits only explicit integration and council never integrates closes or replans directly
rejected no_consensus and blocked_security preserve work and require causal Director replan
admission processing replay and recovery revalidate exact V18 and council digests
same lifecycle writer scheduler CAS event stream outbox and StateRepository remain authoritative

assertions: exact V18 gate opens one round automatically
three distinct council launches produce strict artifacts and ballots
two accepts plus one reject persist accepted decision and dissent only after ballot three
explicit integration revalidates both gate digests
restart replay duplicates no launch fact decision or integration
cross subject generation and launch substitution fail
stale Director lease or fence cannot open
live Director opens exactly one round and three roles
a second exact subject with accept reject abstain persists no_consensus and three dissent facts
typed arbiter security veto with evidence produces blocked_security
veto remains durable after restart and integration stays blocked
ACK text severity or incomplete artifact cannot become veto or ballot
only authorized human platform_admin project_owner or operator may skip
principal reason UTC spec hash idempotency and exact subject are mandatory
skip before round schedules zero council launches
same replay returns exact skip and changed replay payload fails
cross project generation subject and post round skip fail
explicit integration still revalidates exact V18 gate
